title: Default test script may enter Vitest watch mode
reasoning: The `test` script invokes `vitest` without `run`, while the coverage and integration scripts explicitly use `vitest run`. Vitest's bare command can start watch mode in local/non-CI environments, so `npm run test` may not terminate when used by automation, pre-submit hooks, or developer scripts that expect a one-shot test command.
reproduction: Run `npm run test` in an interactive non-CI shell; Vitest may remain in watch mode instead of exiting after the suite completes.
recommendation: Change the package script to `vitest run --exclude '**/*.integration.test.ts'` and add a separate watch script such as `test:watch` if watch mode is desired.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No tests or CI configuration are included that assert the package script terminates in non-CI environments.
minimumFixScope: Update only the `scripts.test` command in `package.json`, optionally adding a dedicated watch script.
